2921-3139-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.
2921-3139-5660-6769.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
2921-3139-5660-6769.description:
Cast The Great Henge by paying {G}{G}. 
When The Great Henge enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate The Great Henge by tapping it, adding {G}{G} and causing you to gain 2 life.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing The Great Henge, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning The Great Henge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat

2440-3517-5641.easyPrerequisites:

Basking Broodscale has a +1/+1 counter on it.

Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each creature that shares a creature type with the creature that entered the battlefield.
Resolve the Tainted Observer trigger, causing you to pay {2} to put a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

141-413-653.description:
Cast Fearsome Awakening by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it and Blasting Station trigger, with Naru Meha targeting Fearsome Awakening.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Naru Meha, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Fearsome Awakening
Resolve the Fearsome Awakening copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

2292-2577-6763-7084.easyPrerequisites:

2292-2577-6763-7084.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
When Gravecrawler dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land that can tap to produce at least {B}.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding at least {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

Cast Combat Celebrant by paying {2}{R} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Combat Celebrant enters, its offspring ability triggers, creating a token copy of it that is 1/1.
At the beginning of your combat phase, Nesting Dovehawk triggers, creating a copy of the Combat Celebrant token.
Declare a Combat Celebrant token as an attacker, choosing to exert it as it attacks. It then triggers, untapping all other creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

Cast Multiversal Incursion for free due to Vision, creating a nonlegendary token copy of each nontoken creature you control.
When the Pinnacle Monk token enters, it triggers, returning Multiversal Incursion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2653-2893-6763-7941.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

549-5413-6871--183.manaNeeded: {0} plus the cost of the creature that earthbends
549-5413-6871--183.description:
Cast the earthbending creature by paying its mana cost.
When you cast that spell, you lose 1 life and create a 2/2 artifact creature token.
The earthbending creature enters as an artifact land creature due to Biotransference and Toph.
When that creature enters, it earthbends, causing itself to become a land creature with haste, putting at least one +1/+1 counter on itself, and creating a delayed triggered ability.
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing that creature.
When that creature dies, the delayed ability from step 4 triggers, causing it to return to the battlefield tapped as an artifact land creature.
Repeat from step 3 any number of times.
Resolve all activated abilities from Trenching Steed.

2350-4399-4770-7818.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Stone Calendar.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Liliana the Faultless triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Whitemane Lion. When it enters, it and Liliana the Faultless trigger.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Liliana the Faultless trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
2350-4399-4770-7818.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Whitemane Lion for the first time.

1836-2348-4019--85.notablePrerequisites: You have a land card in hand that can add {U} and that shares a name with at least two other lands you control.
1836-2348-4019--85.description:
Play the land.
That land enters as a creature due to Nature's Revolt, triggering Vigean Graftmage's Graft ability, allowing you to move a +1/+1 counter from Vigean Graftmage to that land.
Activate that land by tapping it, adding one mana.
Sasaya's Essence triggers, adding at least two additional mana.
Activate Vigean Graftmage by paying {1}{U}, untapping the land creature.
Repeat.
1836-2348-4019--85.notes:
Note that either the land or the additional mana source must add blue mana.

You may wait a turn after playing the land instead of using the haste enabler.

1545-4399-4518-6626.description:

Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Trostani trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Trostani trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
1545-4399-4518-6626.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

When Selesnya Sanctuary enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.

Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

4083-6899-7167.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal damage to Wrathful Raptors.

4083-6899-7167.description:
Deal damage to Wrathful Raptors.

Resolve the Wrathful Raptors trigger, dealing damage to an applicable target.
Resolve the Repercussion trigger, dealing damage to Wrathful Raptors instead of you due to With Great Power....
Repeat from step 2.

5147-5310-5929-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
5147-5310-5929-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

967-2292-3809-6753-7087.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

Move to your postcombat main phase. You will not lose the mana due to Ashling.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.

3750-6102-7025.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can activate Avatar Roku infinitely to give your red creatures infinite power.

Cast Jeweled Lotus by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Emry.
When Emry enters, it triggers, causing you to mill four cards.
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Repeat.

Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.

Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Faith's Reward
Resolve the Faith's Reward copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

When Greenwarden of Murasa and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Displace from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.

3647-3821-4477.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

When Felidar Guardian enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.
